name: Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Kuta
short_description: A select-service Four Points a short walk from Kuta Beach, with a lagoon-style pool and a central Kuta location near restaurants and nightlife.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Kuta sits a short walk from Kuta Beach in a central Kuta location surrounded by restaurants, shops, and nightlife. Rated 4 of 5 across roughly 1,500 TripAdvisor reviews, it ranks in the top tier among Kuta's roughly 290 hotels, with guests consistently praising the spacious lagoon-style pool, comfortable rooms with reliable wifi and air conditioning, and a breakfast buffet described as having plenty of high-quality variety. Staff are repeatedly singled out for polite, warm service that leaves guests feeling well cared for. As a select-service property in a busy tourist district, the resort has had some maintenance-related feedback in reviews, though hotel management has been noted as responsive and committed to addressing these issues. A separate but consistent watchout mentioned by guests is traffic congestion getting into and out of the immediate area during peak times, a function of Kuta's dense, high-traffic tourist infrastructure rather than the hotel itself. For travelers who want a central, walkable Kuta base with a strong pool and breakfast at select-service pricing, it's a solidly reviewed option among Bali's Bonvoy properties.

faqs.question: Is Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Kuta close to Kuta Beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's a short walk from Kuta Beach, in a central Kuta location surrounded by restaurants, shops, and nightlife.

faqs.question: What do guests say about the pool at Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Kuta?
faqs.answer: The lagoon-style pool draws consistent praise in reviews as spacious and enjoyable, and it's frequently mentioned alongside the hotel's breakfast buffet as one of the property's strongest features.

reviews.title: Review: Four Points by Sheraton Bali, Kuta | Marriott Bonvoy
reviews.author: Audrey Voisine
reviews.summary: A family of four found the Category 3 Bonvoy hotel well located for Kuta nightlife, but rated the rooms cramped and short on privacy; breakfast, the kids' club and dining were the highlights.

reviews.title: Review: Four Points By Sheraton Bali, Kuta (Family Suite)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Upgraded to a Family Suite, the reviewer was let down by dark, poorly maintained rooms with privacy issues and musty-smelling bedsheets, and asked to change rooms.

reviews.title: 3 Select Marriott Hotels in Bali Reviewed: Which Ones Impressed?
reviews.author: Ehsan Haque
reviews.summary: The writer enjoyed a spacious lagoon-access suite and standout service, including an anniversary touch, though noted some wear and a crowded breakfast with flies.

reviews.title: Four Points by Sheraton Bali Kuta Review: Breakfast, Pool, and Location
reviews.author: Sinae
reviews.summary: At roughly USD 70 a night the four-star property offered strong value, with a generous breakfast and accommodating staff offsetting minor gripes like the narrow access road.
